cases.query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.VIEW.TABLES(), "Name", [Name], "DataCategory", [DataCategory], "Description", [Description], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "CalculationGroupPrecedence", [CalculationGroupPrecedence])
rows: Customer companies that opportunities are sold to, with their region, market segment, and location.
Individual sales opportunities (deals) with their names, size classification, and priority rank.
Channel partners involved in selling, including whether the deal was partner-driven.
Products available for sale, identified by product code.
Sales pipeline stages and the win probability associated with each stage.
Key business metrics for tracking sales performance, revenue, and pipeline health.
Date dimension for time-based analysis. Marked as a date table.

cases.query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(INFO.VIEW.COLUMNS(), [Type] <> "RowNumber"), "Table", [Table], "Name", [Name], "DataType", [DataType], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "FormatString", [FormatString], "SortByColumn", [SortByColumn], "SummarizeBy", [SummarizeBy], "DataCategory", [DataCategory], "DisplayFolder", [DisplayFolder], "Description", [Description], "Expression", [Expression])
rows: Sales region the account belongs to (e.g., East, West).
Market segment classification of the account (e.g., Enterprise, SMB).
U.S. state where the account is located.
Name of the individual sales opportunity (deal).
Deal size classification (e.g., Small, Medium, Large, Strategic).
Name of the channel partner involved in the deal.
Indicates whether the opportunity was driven by the partner (Yes/No).
Estimated win probability associated with each sales stage.
Named stage of the sales pipeline (e.g., Prospect, Qualify, Solution, Proposal, Close).
Estimated date the opportunity is expected to close.
Calendar date (day grain) used for time-based analysis. Marked as the model's date column.
Calendar month name, sorted in calendar order.
Year and month combined (e.g., 2015-Jan), sorted in calendar order.
Day of the week name (Monday–Sunday), sorted starting with Monday.

cases.query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(INFO.VIEW.MEASURES(), "Table", [Table], "Name", [Name], "IsHidden", [IsHidden], "DisplayFolder", [DisplayFolder], "Description", [Description], "Expression", [Expression])
rows: Average number of days an opportunity stays active before close.
Average revenue per opportunity in the current filter context.
Revenue weighted by the sales-stage win probability — a probability-adjusted view of pipeline value.
Number of opportunities in the current filter context.
Total product revenue (unweighted) across selected opportunities.
Total number of days opportunities have been active (sum of Opportunity Days).
